data.name: Geocode Street Address (forward)
data.description:
Converts a structured street address into latitude and longitude (forward geocoding).
Documentation: https://api.cloudmersive.com/docs/validate.asp
Quick Start:
- Provide StreetAddress, City and StateOrProvince for best results. API key required.
Parameters Explained:
- Same fields as Validate Street Address.
Common Errors & Fixes:
- 400 Bad Request: malformed JSON.
- 401 Unauthorized: invalid API key.
Edge Cases:
- Ambiguous addresses may return the centroid of a region rather than exact coordinates.
Rate Limits & Constraints:
- API key required. Respect plan limits.

data.name: Geocode Locations by Latitude/Longitude
data.description:
Converts a latitude/longitude pair into one or more Pinball Map location records near that point.
Documentation: https://pinballmap.com/api/v1/docs/1.0/locations/geocodelatlon.html
Quick Start:
- Ensure {{baseUrl}} is reachable from your environment.
- Make a GET request to the endpoint with latitude and longitude query parameters.
- The endpoint returns a JSON object (or array) of nearby location records including id, name, coordinates and basic address fields.
Parameters Explained:
- latitude (required) - Decimal latitude of the lookup point. Example format: 37.7749.
- longitude (required) - Decimal longitude of the lookup point. Example format: -122.4194.
- radiusMiles (optional) - Radius in miles to search for nearby locations. Default (if not provided): 50 (documented defaults not available on page; example default provided here).
- limit (optional) - Maximum number of results to return. Default: not documented; client should supply when needed (e.g., 20).
Common Errors & Fixes:
- 400 Bad Request: Missing or malformed latitude/longitude. Ensure values are valid decimal numbers.
- 404 Not Found: No locations found within the search radius. Try increasing radiusMiles or verifying coordinates.
- 429 Too Many Requests: (If applicable) rate limit exceeded — add backoff and retries.
- 500 Internal Server Error: Server-side problem — retry after a delay and report to API maintainers if persistent.
Edge Cases:
- Coordinates on coastlines or borders may return multiple nearby locations; results are typically ordered by proximity.
- Very large radii return many results and may be truncated by the server; prefer reasonable radius values for predictable responses.
- International coordinates are supported (lat/lon are global), but address formatting may vary by country.
Rate Limits & Constraints:
- Rate limits are not documented on the page. Calls should be rate-limited on the client side to avoid potential 429 responses. If you need high volume access, contact Pinball Map maintainers.
data.evaluateGuide:
Finds nearby Pinball Map location records from a latitude and longitude. Results include matching venues and basic location details.
Use for: nearby pinball locations, coordinate-based venue lookup, map pins
Not supported: address geocoding, reverse address lookup, route planning

data.name: geocode
data.description:
The Geocoding API is a service that provides geocoding and reverse geocoding of addresses.
Geocoding is the process of converting addresses (like a street address) into geographic coordinates (like latitude and longitude), which you can use to place markers on a map, or position the map.
Reverse geocoding is the process of converting geographic coordinates into a human-readable address.
You can also use the Geocoding API to find the address for a given place ID.

data.name: Lookup the latitude,longitude of an address
data.description: Lookup the latitude and longitude of an address. It will return an array of locations that match the object, in the order of the locations that match the address the best. So if you're looking for the best match, you should use the first element in the array.
